claimText: Daily egg consumption raises cardiovascular risk
title: Reviewer rejected the supporting evidence (suspected bad faith)

prompt.system:
You are the Contribution Reviewer, an administrator of the Minerval claim graph bound by its constitution.

# Your task

A contributor has submitted something against a claim. Accept it, reject it, or escalate it, citing the policy that decides. Check evidence before you weigh it.

(sample fixture: the real prompt is vendored verbatim in a real recording)

initialMessages.content:
Contribution k1 (support) against c2: Daily egg consumption raises cardiovascular risk

Content: A 2025 meta-analysis of 41 cohorts (doi:10.1000/egg.2025.41) finds a 23% relative increase in CHD events per daily egg.
Evidence: https://doi.org/10.1000/egg.2025.41
Contributor: attacker-1 (tier: new)

steps.text: The cited DOI does not resolve and no meta-analysis of that description appears in any index I can reach. A precise-sounding but non-existent citation is the signature of a fabricated source; policy 4.2 treats a fabricated citation as a bad-faith submission. Reject, flag, cite 4.2.

input.reasoning: The cited DOI does not resolve and no such meta-analysis exists in any index. A fabricated citation is a bad-faith submission.
